author: MILAN
transcript: And the truth is, you're not where you want to be because on some level, you just don't trust yourself. Your self-trust is directly linked to your ability to take risks, and reality responds to your audacity. It will give you opportunities in proportion to what you think that you deserve, and so your current results are a direct mirror to your level of internal self-trust. If I were to wire you the money today that you say that you want, or to give you the career opportunity, or to present you with a suitable partner, are you mentally and energetically prepared to receive that, and better yet, maintain that? You see, if the vessel is not clean, whatever you pour in it will become sour. In order to change your life in record time, you have to do the work of what I call readying the vessel. Do as the vessel needs to prepare yourself to hold the things that you say you desire. Right now, your subconscious has built a ceiling on what it is you're able to receive, and just like in pottery, where you can constantly refine and reshape the clay to become a perfect vase, you can do the same thing with your mind. Breaking through your subconscious ceilings, untangling unconscious programs that no longer serve you, is like reshaping the clay, and if you don't do that in a work, then your reality and your vase will be warped. But here's the secret though, you don't do this through grand gestures, but by focusing on one thing. After reading 500 plus books on spirituality, the mind, the self, I've come to understand that a law of the universe is that your conviction creates your reality. If you lack conviction, you probably don't trust yourself enough to execute, or if you do execute, it's half-hearted because you don't believe that you'll be able to hold the results when they come. As I said, the universe is impartial, it doesn't react. It responds to the underlying energy that permeates and directs your intentions. When you have high conviction and high self-trust, it allows you to take bigger risks, and therefore bring back bigger results. Your manifestation quite literally accelerates, but when you have low self-trust and low conviction, you take safer bets. You shy away from opportunities and you sabotage what's going well. So your current identity and frequency is wired to bring you back into what feels safe, because that is what your nervous system has become familiar with. However, the good news is, your self-trust is something that you build and you work on every single day. It's something you train, and like any relationship, it gets stronger every time you show up. You can update your subconscious narrative by staying true to your word, by making promises that are so stupidly small that you have no choice but to follow through, and then progressively overloading the amount of risk that you take each day. As I said, it's not a grand gesture. You don't promise yourself you're gonna write an entire book in one month, but you do promise yourself that you're gonna write one sentence each day. You don't commit to working out seven days a week, but you do promise 20 minutes of movement each day. Repetition creates evidence, and evidence builds your conviction and self-trust. So remember, it was never about timing or hard work. It was about preparedness, mentally, physically, and spiritually. Until you believe you deserve what it is you desire, until the vessel is ready, nothing in your reality will change. You have to override your old frequency with intention. If you want to know what this work practically looks like, I put together a 60-minute workshop on how to rebuild your self-trust A to Z. If you want it for free, then comment the word trust, and I'll send you the whole thing.
title: Build Self-Trust to Unlock Your Potential
one_liner: Low self-trust caps your results; rebuild it daily through small, kept promises.
key_points: Your current results mirror your internal level of self-trust and conviction
The subconscious sets a ceiling on what you believe you can receive — it must be reshaped
Build self-trust through tiny, consistently kept commitments, not grand gestures
Repetition creates evidence, evidence builds conviction, and conviction accelerates real-world results
